# Fujian Xiahua Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd.

Premium B2B manufacturing independent site for high-performance ABS faucet handles, adjustable shower sliders, and precision sanitary brass fittings.

## Corporate Identity
- **Company Name:** Fujian Xiahua Sanitary Ware Co., Ltd. (福建厦华卫浴有限公司)
- **HQ Address:** Plumbing Manufacturing Zone, Nan'an, Quanzhou, Fujian, China (中国·福建·泉州市南安市水暖工业制造园)
- **Primary Markets:** Southeast Asia, South America, Middle East.
- **Languages Supported:** English (Default), Russian (Русский), Portuguese (Português), Hindi (हिन्दी), Chinese (中文).

## Core Export Product Portfolio
1. **ABS Material Faucet Handles (Model: XH-ABS-101)**
   - High-grade impact-resistant virgin ABS, multilayer electroplated chrome, compliant with BS EN 200 standard, salt spray tested for over 48 hours.
2. **Shower Slider & Slider Sleeves (Model: XH-SHSL-202)**
   - Adjustable ABS shower rail slide sleeve, smooth sliding friction pads, tested for 100,000 cycles, fits standard 22mm/25mm shower rods.
3. **Precision Brass Water Diverter Core (Model: XH-BRFC-303)**
   - Low-lead H59 dezincification-resistant solid brass casting, durable ceramic cartridge tested for 500,000 drip-free cycles, WRAS water safety compliant.
4. **Solid Brass Bath & Basin Tap Body (Model: XH-FC-03)**
   - Heavy gravity-casted brass body preventing cold weather cracking, mirror polished chrome finish.

## Quality Certification & Standards
- ISO 9001:2015 Manufacturing Quality Certified.
- WRAS / EN 817 Drinking Water Safety Compliant.
- BS EN 200 / AS/NZS Standard Hydraulics Bench Tested.
- SGS Heavy Metal Leaching Analysis Approved.
